content: Root cause: The bug in the `CommonGramsQueryFilter` was due to the incorrect handling of position increments and position lengths for tokens, which resulted in a disconnected token graph. This disconnection interfered with the proper functioning of phrase queries during query parsing. Specifically, when the filter processed tokens of type "gram," it did not reset the position length to 1, leading to gaps in the token graph that caused phrase queries to fail. The patch added logic to ensure that the position length is set back to 1 when processing gram types, thereby maintaining a complete and connected token graph.

Code statements:
```java
+          // We must set this back to 1 (from e.g. 2 or higher) otherwise the token graph is disconnected:
+          posLengthAttribute.setPositionLength(1);
```
```java
+      // We must set this back to 1 (from e.g. 2 or higher) otherwise the token graph is disconnected:
+      posLengthAttribute.setPositionLength(1);
```
